PLAN "12-Week General Fitness Program for 58-year-old male post-MI (moderate-intensity, HR cap 115 bpm)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve general fitness and functional capacity within moderate-intensity, HR-controlled limits"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to resistance and conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          chest_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          lat_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression and stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Technique and light load":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          overhead_press 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          split_squat 2x10..15 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Recovery and scope check":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Progressive loading with cadence control":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Technique and endurance":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
          calf_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Balance and mobility focus":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..20 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
          figure_four_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Assess and adjust":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_stretch 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength progression with control":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Endurance and stability":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..15 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Heart-rate aware deload":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cable_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 2x8..12 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Program consolidation and testing":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_stretch 60 seconds

END
